theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+0.86%) and Industrials (+0.80%) led the market today, while Energy (-0.80%) and Communication Svcs (-0.72%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.12%, defensives +0.44%, and value/cyclicals +0.15% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.51%, Dow +0.93%, Nasdaq +0.48% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at +0.07%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 5.11% to 14.87, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.34% to $4,320.50, crude oil was little changed at $92.44, and bitcoin slipped 0.38% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
